title: AI gen for trailers
author: Kindly_Access7577
selftext:
PSA You can get really far with agents generating high quality trailers with your in game assets. Point your agent at your repo and ask jt to use your brand messaging, fonts, colors and even create a custom song if you need it. It also helps for iteration to ask for storyboards and beats early on before committing changes to final results. 

Above is a trailer I generated for Puzzleform.

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body:
this is pretty nice

my opinion is that the 15 second format doesn't give you enough time to communicate your game, however.  have you considered making a longer one

replies.author: Kindly_Access7577
replies.body:

Yes, and agents can cut shorter and longer formats as needed. Though for this app I tend to use a long form gameplay for general marketing cause it conveys how the app plays on headsets better
